messages:
ops_lead: @here Quick advance notice — we're scheduling a short maintenance window for the Hosted API networking layer. Window: 2028-11-18 02:00 -> 04:00 UTC. Purpose: egress firewall rule rotation + LB patch. Expected customer-facing impact: brief spikes in streaming latency and rare 503s for up to ~30s while connections drain. No DB migrations. :warning:

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/maint-1842501234 (visibility: public). Reminder will post 48h and 1h before if window is unchanged.

support_sara: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb I can paste into support replies? Also want a badge to add to the support dashboard.

ops_lead: Yes — draft pasted below (short + plain):

```
Subject: Planned maintenance — Hosted API (Nov 18, 02:00-04:00 UTC)

Hi — we will perform routine networking maintenance on Nov 18 from 02:00–04:00 UTC. During the window clients may see short streaming latency spikes or transient 5xx errors for a small fraction of requests. No data will be modified. If you have critical workloads that cannot tolerate any interruption, please email trustops@redwood.example and we can discuss options (dedicated capacity or delaying maintenance).

Status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/maint-1842501234

Thanks — Redwood Operations
```

maria_engineering: Oncall coverage? I have a deploy at 01:30 UTC that might overlap. Sam, can you take primary pager through the window? I'll be on standby for escalations after 02:30 UTC.

sam_oncall: I can be primary pager for the window. Escalation path: me -> maria_engineering -> ops_lead. Pager rule: 5m -> 10m -> pager escalation. I'll join the maintenance call at 01:50 UTC. If we see >5% 5xxs for >3m or tokens/sec drops >25% open incident and page.

ops_lead: Thanks. Runbook highlights (short):
- Precheck 01:45 UTC: LB health + KV cache hitrate baseline.
- Drain node group A one-by-one, monitor 5xx/latency.
- Apply egress rule rotation (30s config flip per AZ).
- Verify streaming reconnects (test clients).
- If error spike >10% or prolonged >5m, abort and roll back to previous rule.
- Postcheck 03:30 UTC: full synthetic checks and traffic sampling for regressions.

deploy-bot: Maintenance job scheduled:
```
# job: maint/egress-rotation
trigger: 2028-11-18T02:00:00Z
steps:
  - drain: asg-nodegroup-A
  - apply: egress-rule-v3
  - verify: synthetic-stream-checks
  - drain: asg-nodegroup-B
```

ops_lead: Small change: cloud provider sent a heads-up that the host-level patch window shifted earlier by 1 hour. Proposed new window: 01:00 -> 03:00 UTC. Impact profile unchanged. If anyone objects, speak up now — we need to lock the status page message and customer email.

support_sara: Moving earlier is fine for customers in NA/APAC, but check EU product teams for scheduled demos. I'll queue a targeted email to the 24 customers with dedicated SLAs.

maria_engineering: I can shift my standby earlier; sam do you still cover primary?

sam_oncall: Confirmed — still primary. I'll update responders in the pager config. Also adding a temporary route to preferred fallback model shard in case LB rotation causes connection storms.

ops_lead: Status page draft (short public message) — please sanity check: 

```
We will perform scheduled network maintenance on Nov 18 from 01:00–03:00 UTC affecting the Hosted API. Users may experience short streaming interruptions and transient 5xx responses. We will post live updates here. No data loss expected.
```

statusbot: Status page update scheduled: draft published to Scheduled Maintenance section. Public URL: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/maint-1842501234#scheduled

support_sara: Customer email queued for the general list. For enterprise customers: forwarding to account leads with a suggested note bundle.

--- (maintenance window in progress) ---

sam_oncall: 01:02 UTC — started draining nodegroup-A. Monitoring: 200sps baseline unchanged, 5xx at 0.2% currently.

maria_engineering: 01:18 UTC — applied egress-rule-v3 to AZ-1. Brief 20s spike to 2% 5xx during switchback. Rolling forward.

sam_oncall: 01:35 UTC — observed a reconnect storm from a subset of streaming clients when we drained nodegroup-B. Thundering herd reduced by applying backoff rule and enabling synthetic delay smoothing. Opened internal incident shorthand: INC-1842501. Paging maria_engineering (escalating).

maria_engineering: Oncall jump-in. Initiated temporary rollback of backpressure config — reducing burst reconnects. Monitoring now: 5xx down to 0.8%, latency back to baseline in 4m.

ops_lead: Good containment. Logging the customer impact estimate: ~0.3% of total requests experienced transient errors for <30s. No enterprise SLAs breached. Prepare postmortem notes and customer advisory template for any outbound follow-up.

support_sara: Drafting a short advisory to impacted customers:
```
We experienced brief, transient streaming interruptions during a scheduled maintenance at 01:35 UTC. The issue affected a small portion of requests; the system recovered automatically within ~4 minutes. No data was lost. If you observed a longer outage, please reply and we'll investigate.
```

statusbot: Incident status update: Maintenance in progress -> Partial Impact. Public timeline updated at 01:40 UTC.

--- (maintenance complete) ---

sam_oncall: 02:52 UTC — final postcheck completed. All nodegroups healthy. Synthetic checks green. Latency and 5xx within baseline.

ops_lead: Maintenance complete. Moving status to Completed / Resolved. Posting final customer message now. :white_check_mark:

statusbot: Status page updated to Resolved: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/maint-1842501234#resolved — final note: brief transient 5xx spikes during egress rotation; no data loss; normal traffic restored.

support_sara: Customer advisory sent to affected list and enterprise contacts. Will follow up with one-off remediation for any customers who saw duplicate events.

maria_engineering: Thanks team. I'll capture the timeline and quick blameless notes for the postmortem doc. Sam, can you add the exact pager logs to the incident thread?

sam_oncall: Yep — adding logs to internal incident doc and will hand off to maria at 03:10 UTC for postmortem write-up. Closing this thread for day-to-day alerts.

ops_lead: Appreciated — nice containment and quick rollback when needed. If anyone wants to add follow-ups for the postmortem deck, drop them in #postmortems.

support_sara: Closing support ticket queue entry and marking notifications as sent.
